decisions.summary: Check brief: every finding of one report applied in one message, record commands and tests once
research/CLAUDE.md trimmed to rules (11,100 chars); full text moved verbatim to docs/research-record-rules.md; plan claims 'No rule is dropped'
decisions.why: Round after digest 67a79810: every rule on the previous list is now in research/CLAUDE.md under its heading - (259) glossary.json/glossary.js never hand-edited; (190) no link to a URL nobody fetched, percent-decoded URL search, Pointers item plain, REGISTERED name linked; (194) roster key with nothing to quote leaves, translator named, own English needs no note; (195) Not cited, settled re-opens, the GM-downloaded copy (read the copy, link the public page, quote-check the copy), abstract-only citation, several GROUNDS reasons and the written argument; (209) definitions from the record's text, two agents in one turn (spec 209 D5); (211) NOT-APPLICABLE assertions keep their label until the GM rules; (229) pixel figure in a comment, retired once encoded, the why on the page with the comment pointing at the anchor. The re-check of 37c20e57's file that the caller asked for, read in full, finds operative rules the previous list also missed, still absent, so 'keeps every rule' remains false and the adopted R3 rec 4 ('trim to its operative rules') is still narrowed: (195) a CITATION link is the full-text view rather than a library landing page, and the original-language page rather than an English rendering that is on no page; what a read copy does NOT say is written down where the claim stands, the rest labeled GUESS; settling an absence note is never obligatory; and the restored GROUNDS sentence drops 'on an existing note' - the old rule required the written argument only for using an unexemplified reason ON AN EXISTING NOTE, the new text requires it for any use, which is a changed rule, not a compacted one; (190) a page named only as silent or unreadable, and an unregistered summary-only or withdrawn item, stay plain (only the Pointers case is kept); a new registry entry records the URL and the READ date; (194) the quotation form holds in body prose and in a SOURCES.html entry as well; the original is the checker's anchor, never a second quote; a sentence resting on two sources carries two footnotes; (209) a Sources-roster key's parenthetical says what the work contributed, nothing about when or how it was read; an absence note's provenance ('the passage came from key') is an HTML comment in its li; (229) a spec paragraph names no engine identifier OR CHECK in its visible text, and where it rests on no finding says which - a convention, a calibration against the drawn exhibits, or a guess. Sections 260, 259, 258, 180, 183, 211 (apart from the above), HTML and 234 lose only rationale, mechanics a tool performs, or enforcement facts; no finding there. Restore each item compactly under its heading (restore 'on an existing note' verbatim), then re-state the plan's size figure with an observed label: the file now measures 12,393 characters / 12,409 bytes (observed 2026-09-26, python len and wc -c), and the plan's 12,400 and 43,500 carry no m: key or one-shot label. Nothing makes keeping these impossible or defeats the rec's purpose; they are a few hundred characters.
